correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the result for iid uniform q-ary words with replacement, excluding distance zero. A common neighbor of a distance-one pair either uses a new distinguishing value with zero or one extra change, or uses an endpoint value with exactly one extra change. For distance two, the choices are two mixed endpoint combinations, one or two new values, or a mixed endpoint combination with one extra change. These give exactly c1 and c2. Conditional on the two words, each third word supplies an iid four-outcome trial; conditioning further only on the edge mixes the two powers with the stated weights. Both single-coordinate means stay p, so no between-type covariance term is missing. Forest independence follows by conditional leaf integration. Of distinct triples of edges only triangles contribute, and pairwise independence annihilates terms with exactly one repetition; the triangle centered moment is pΔ. Independently checked S1, S2, S3, binary S4, the two shifted base polynomials and the monotonicity certificate described below. For the cumulant sign, adding a Hamming coordinate changes p by (b/q)(Pr{H=0}−Pr{H=2}) for H∼Bin(d,b/q); this is negative for d≥3. In negative-Δ regimes p≥1/2, including equality at (2,1), and in positive-Δ regimes p≤1/2 except at (4,3). There p=9/16, Δ=5/256 and direct substitution gives the claimed 5n−17 factor. This checks d=1, n=3 and all strict/no-zero assertions.

value.rationale: The first natural non-nearest-neighbor Hamming connection set already gives three distinct onset dimensions across alphabets. The exact covariance and its sign distinguish dependence hidden by pairwise independence; the lone finite-sample skewness reversal shows why triangle sign is not the entire edge-count story. This is a complete reusable classification of a canonical radius-two model, not a small numerical slice or a claim to have invented signed triangles.
residual_risks: The law is for labelled iid words with repeats and edge-conditioned degrees, not single-realization assortativity, other connection sets or a stochastic ordering.
